scope: Realm localization texts in the forgot-password, execute-actions and verify-email mails: the user locale, realm texts over the email theme messages for subjects and bodies, a realm without texts, internationalization off, and a text added later.
normalization: The base URL and realm names are replaced with placeholders; mails keep their recipients, subject, text part and the HTML part reduced to its words, with action links as {link}, and the number of links in the HTML part.

mails.subject: Realm actions EN
mails.text:
Your administrator has just requested that you update your {Realm-texts} account by performing the following action(s): Realm password action. Click on the link below to start this process.
